scenario: [LSER.16.4.1] percentiles compute end-to-end over the SeriesBackendRingBuffer raw-sample window (interpolated, LSER.17.2). Option B (RFC_builtin_op_enum): pN lowers to the single FN_SERIES_PERCENTILE op with the percentile N threaded as the call's value argument through query_with_value — so the runtime must route each pN to ds_series_ring_buffer_percentile(N), threading distinct N per call. This vector is DISCRIMINATING: over the ascending window 10,20,..,100 the median stays ~55 while p95 climbs to ~95, and the rule fires only when `p50 <= 60 AND p95 >= 80`. No single percentile value satisfies both bounds (60 < 80), so the log appears ONLY if p50 and p95 resolve to distinct, correct values — i.e. N (50 vs 95) is threaded to the right argument. A composition bug (N to the wrong arg, both reading the same kind, or the percentile off) leaves the condition unsatisfiable and drops the event. Pin: action_log appears.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

series Reading.val:
    p50 sliding 1h
    p95 sliding 1h

rule pctl_discriminates:
    Reading r where p50(r.val) <= 60.0 and p95(r.val) >= 80.0
->
    log info "p50<=60 and p95>=80"
